def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def analyze(n):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; out=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    bgc=collections.Counter(x for row in inp for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]!=bgc]
    e={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if out[i][j]==5}
    return inp,out,bgc,H,W,seeds,e

import numpy as np, collections
# Rule candidate: billiard rays from each seed, reflect off ALL four walls, paint every visited bg cell, stop after N reflections? Test on demos & count exact match.
def simulate(inp, reflect=True, paint_even=False, step_limit=None):
    inp=np.array(inp); out=inp.copy()
    bgc=collections.Counter(inp.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=inp.shape
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]!=bgc]
    p=set()
    for s in seeds:
        for dr,dc in [(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]:
            r,c=s; d=0
            while True:
                d+=1
                nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W):
                    dr=-dr if nr<0 else dr
                    dc=-dc if nc<0 else dc
                    nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
